paragraphs.title: Velmora Institute
paragraphs.text: The Velmora Institute is a research university in the city of Ostrand. It was founded in 1891 by the chemist Idris Kael.

paragraphs.title: Idris Kael
paragraphs.text: Idris Kael was a chemist born in the village of Brennock. Kael is best known for discovering the compound tessarine.

paragraphs.title: Brennock
paragraphs.text: Brennock is a fishing village on the coast of Lysmar. Brennock has a population of about 900 people.

paragraphs.title: Ostrand
paragraphs.text: Ostrand is the capital of the province of Calder. Ostrand sits on the Mirel River.

paragraphs.title: Calder
paragraphs.text: Calder is a province in the republic of Lysmar. The governor of Calder is Sefa Odun.

paragraphs.title: Sefa Odun
paragraphs.text: Sefa Odun is a politician who studied law at the Harlow College. Odun became governor in 2019.

paragraphs.title: Harlow College
paragraphs.text: Harlow College is a liberal arts college in the town of Pellin. Harlow College was founded in 1902.

paragraphs.title: Tessarine
paragraphs.text: Tessarine is a blue crystalline compound used in early photographic plates.

paragraphs.title: Mirel River
paragraphs.text: The Mirel River flows 410 kilometres from the Dun Mountains to the Grey Sea.

paragraphs.title: Dun Mountains
paragraphs.text: The Dun Mountains are a range in northern Lysmar whose highest peak is Mount Arrow.

paragraphs.title: Northwind Orchestra
paragraphs.text: The Northwind Orchestra is based in Pellin. Its principal conductor is Mara Voss.

paragraphs.title: Mara Voss
paragraphs.text: Mara Voss is a conductor who was born in Ostrand in 1975.

paragraphs.title: Pellin
paragraphs.text: Pellin is a market town in the province of Varro, known for its wool trade.

paragraphs.title: Varro
paragraphs.text: Varro is a province in the republic of Lysmar. Its capital is Quell.
